name: Set Points Health
description: Set Points is a digital tool that will aim to help diabetic patients save their legs. Most diabetic apps and programmes focus on structured education, diets and carb counting. Set Points shifts its focus to the user, and allows them to track their health while staying connected to friends, family and experts. It will show users where they fit in the spectrum of diabetes and how to avoid complications such as blindness, kidney failure and amputations. Set Points believes that the app is highly scalable and could help alleviate the burden of routine GP appointments.

" " Flexera Software is the leading provider of strategic solutions for Application Usage Management. Flexera Software helps application producers and their customers strategically manage application usage to achieve continuous compliance, optimised usage and maximised value. The producer and consumer communities have moved beyond just tactical tools for application administration to now seek strategic solutions for Application Usage Management. Application Usage Management;Application usage has turned strategic, in the enterprise, application usage has moved from aiding the business to running the business, the competitive edge in hardware is increasingly based upon the applications inside, and, the strategic future for applications is highly optimised usage-based pricing. Yet application usage is among the least well managed of strategic enterprise resources. The trend to strategically manage application usage has been rapidly driven to a tipping point by large and growing external influences, including;an exponential growth in the numbers of applications and their total monetary value;a transformation in the role of applications from “nice to have tools” to “must have strategic solutions”;the recent, rapid growth in SaaS, cloud, virtualisation and other technology trends;the pressures of a global economy which squeezes every enterprise such that “optimising value” has become a strategic business imperative across all business processes and assets;A highly competitive global economy that drives software developers and hardware manufacturers to better optimise and protect their valuable software assets;The enterprise has awoken to realise that applications are one of the least well managed of all strategic corporate assets. We now see corporate procurement getting more involved, and in some cases assuming leadership, as the enterprise moves beyond a narrow focus on software price discounts to a broader strategy of optimising enterprise-wide usage. IT and procurement executives at the leading enterprises turn to Flexera Software for strategic solutions to drive these key initiatives and to deliver the information they need to ensure their success. The ISV community traditionally focused more on developing and expanding their software product portfolio, now recognises the increasing importance of managing application usage to protect their IP and maximise its value. The same is true for hardware manufacturers. Flexera Software Is Best-in-Class Application Usage Management;For over 20 years companies have turned to us for products to help manage applications. Our comprehensive suite of Application Usage Management solutions—from installation and licensing, entitlement and compliance management to application readiness and enterprise license optimisation — meet the needs of application producers and their customers and deliver continuous compliance, optimised usage and maximised value. Most importantly, our solutions come from a vendor trusted by both producers and their customers and are on over 500 million computers throughout the world. The key to our breakthrough comes from our uniquely valuable position in delivering strategic solutions to both the producer and consumer communities, which has helped us master their differing requirements. Both communities appreciate our large base of end users, supported applications, our trusted relationship with those end users, and our knowledge of how to deliver strategic benefits. The heart of Application Usage Management is information. Both communities tell us the same thing: without Flexera Software solutions they lack the information needed to do the job right – the information needed for continuous compliance, maximised value and optimised usage. We provide this needed information across the application lifecycle, at the right time and place, and with the necessary detail and accuracy. Most importantly, we provide the information needed to drive game changing results – to enable corporate procurement to bring strategic procurement disciplines to one of the least well managed strategic corporate assets and to ensure that developers are optimising the value and protecting the integrity of their intellectual property. The ability to deliver this critically needed information is derived from the embedded automation that has always been the hallmark of our solutions – the needed visibility, transparency, and accuracy that can only come from self-instrumenting the applications, comprehensive solutions for automating information discovery and identification, and proactively monitoring and delivering strategic information. As the pioneer and industry leader of strategic Application Usage Management solutions, Flexera Software has grown to become a large and successful company - a solidly profitable, top 200 software company with over 80,000 customers and market leadership in installation, licensing, entitlement & compliance management, application readiness and enterprise license optimisation.

Labyrinth Biotech Inc will collaborate with multiple universities; hospitals; and companies in clinical projects...""Labyrinth Biotech Inc. focuses on exploring the clinical utilities of liquid biopsy using microfluidic technologies to efficiently capture and analyze circulating tumor cells (CTCs). We are building a comprehensive CTC platform to offer research institute and cancer patients a precise and affordable diagnosis in early risk assessment; screening; treatment; and prognosis. We aim to not only offer products and services; but also create industrial standards in precision medicine through the accumulation of clinical data. Our product based on Labyrinth chip can be applied in every stage of standard care of cancer diagnosis and treatment. It is able to capture viable CTCs from multiple cancers and compatible with various downstream analysis (gene; protein; drug test; PDX; etc.).  Labyrinth Biotech Inc will collaborate with multiple universities; hospitals; and companies in clinical projects as an upstream technology to capture and analyze CTCs from various types of cancers. Labyrinth microfluidic chip was developed in Nagrath Laboratory at the University of Michigan (UM) and patented on September; 2018. The technology was co-invented by Prof. Sunitha Nagrath and Dr. Eric Lin through more than 5 years of development and verified with over 1000 clinical samples. Labyrinth chip is being applied in multiple clinical experiments in collaboration with UM Comprehensive Cancer Center (UMCCC) and demonstrated a clinical sensitivity of 95% in breast cancer; prostate cancer; lung cancer; and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The number of captured CTC is 10 times over the gold standard CellSearch; which is the only approved CTC detection technique by FDA.

Heat-treated timber processes are purely high temperature treatments (170°C – 215°C), which does not alter the cell structure of the timber, but stiffens and makes the cell walls more brittle.

name: Dynamis
description: Smart contracts are powerful means for enforcing rules which hold, transfer, receive, or spend digital assets. Insurance requires much more than the facilitation of trustless payments. The real challenge is figuring out how software code can automate the underwriting of policies, the validation of claims, and the verification of the state of places, people and things in the real world. Dynamis is a smart contract for peer to peer insurance running on the Ethereum platform. It provides supplementary unemployment insurance by using the LinkedIn social network as a reputation system. Applicants for a new policy can use LinkedIn to verify their identity and employment status. Claimants can use their LinkedIn connections to validate that they are looking for work. The exercise of one's social capital within one's social network enables participants to obtain a new policy or open a new claim.

title: RegenNetwork | VentureRadar
description: Regen Network realigns the agricultural economy with ecological health by creating the global market for planetary stewardship. We are creating the peer to peer infrastructure that allows anyone to propose a protocol for the accurate measurement of specific environmental outcomes. We then invite existing academic and scientific communities to comment and upgrade those proposals. name: CarpoNovum
title: CarpoNovum | VentureRadar
description: Every year, around one million people are diagnosed with colon cancer. The majority of the patients are treated with surgery, in which 20–30 centimetres of the colon is removed and a temporary stoma bag is attached to the stomach to prevent infection. However, with a new invention from surgeons Henrik Thorlacius and Anders Grönberg, patients can avoid the stoma, extra operation and unnecessary suffering. With the new technology, which can be compared to a garden hose connector, elastic silicon and plastic rings are used to lengthen the colon. This significantly reduces the risk of leakage and means that the patient avoids having a stoma and an extra operation.

name: Eternal Trusts
description: Nowadays, one of the few methods to guarantee that a financial person's legacy can have a lasting influence is setting up a trust fund, a special type of legal agreement that provides a trusted third party with the right to hold and spend assets for the benefit of the trust settlor. Eternal Trusts combines hybrid intelligence and smart contracts to make the model of a traditional trust fund obsolete and provide an alternative, decentralized financial means to make a long-lasting impact. The "eternal" wallets of ET are built on a blockchain and can operate for centuries, turning to expert voting when needed to seek the best providers that can perform the purposes set by the settlors.

One of the projects includes the MIS, which is short for Minimally Invasive Surgery, and is a revolutionary approach in surgery. This project is a direct collaboration between the researchers at the Robotics and Intelligent Laboratory and the Department of Surgery of the University of California San Francisco. With this development, traditional surgical tools are replaced with robotic instruments and are being controlled by a surgeon using the teleoperation. With this method, researchers are hoping that it would greatly restore the control and sensation capacity of the doctor, which were basically reduced or lost due to the MIS. name: Caliving Benefits
description: Most people purchase life insurance to provide a legacy of financial security at the time of their death. Life insurance is a powerful financial tool that can be used to meet many needs. Most commonly, to provide financial resources to the beneficiaries in event of the death of the insured. But how do you protect against an unforeseen illness? Doesn’t it make sense for the benefits to be extended and be available for the difficult financial times they have to face if a critical or terminal illness precedes death? This is precisely what Living Benefits provide. The industry calls the benefit an “Accelerated Death Benefit Rider.” We refer to it as real Living Benefits life insurance when it allows for the insured to file a claim or take an advance for up to $1 million or 90% of their death benefit during difficult times when they are suffering from a serious illness. description: Michelin is a French tire manufacturer based in Clermont-Ferrand in the Auvergne région of France. It is one of the three largest tire manufacturers in the world along with Bridgestone and Goodyear. In addition to the Michelin brand, it also owns the BFGoodrich, Kleber, Tigar, Riken, Kormoran and Uniroyal (in North America) tire brands. Michelin is also notable for its Red and Green travel guides, its roadmaps, the Michelin stars that the Red Guide awards to restaurants for their cooking, and for its company mascot Bibendum, colloquially known as the Michelin Man.

name: CoviCept Therapeutics
description: CoviCept Therapeutics, Inc. (“CoviCept”) is a California-based company that is developing a small molecule that inhibits the replication of SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) and other RNA viruses. CoviCept’s lead molecule has a unique mechanism of action that is based on interference of a host cell protein and is therefore expected to have a low risk of viral resistance. It has been demonstrated to inhibit SARS-CoV-2 replication in a relevant mammalian model at a clinically relevant dose. A manufacturing process for the lead compound has been established and it has demonstrated good bioavailability and safety in humans in phase 1 studies. CoviCept was founded by Sam Tsimikas, Philip Gordts and Jeffrey Esko, all from the University of California San Diego. The Company’s aim is to initiate a first clinical study in the second half of 2021.

name: InfraMarker (Berntsen International)
description: InfraMarker is a division of Berntsen International, Inc. – a company that has been "Marking the Infrastructure of the World" since 1972. Berntsen is the leading survey marking product firm in North America. Our products have been installed in over 100 countries, used in places as diverse as Mount McKinley to Death Valley, and are found almost everywhere that official boundary and geodetic marking takes place. Our experience with underground RFID dates to 2009 when we began exploring how RFID could enhance the marking of boundaries and infrastructure. During this time, we developed a number of new products and IP in this technology area. In 2012, we recognized that ‘location marking’ was giving way to ‘communication marking’ in the next generation infrastructure marking. As a result, we established InfraMarker in early 2013 as a separate unit to lead this strategy.

name: Elephant Vert
description: The Éléphant Vert Group offers innovative farming solutions for more efficient and sustainable agriculture. Their expertise is based on a strong R&D capability in the field of microorganisms with agricultural purposes: organic amendments, biofertilizers, biostimulants and biopesticides. The company strives for the use of bio-inputs, as a complement, and whenever possible, as a substitute for conventional inputs (chemical pesticides and fertilizers). Éléphant Vert intends to respond to the demand by structuring the offer in all its aspects (industrial, commercial, regulatory, R&D, institutional ...) and hence acting as a catalyst. Éléphant Vert is financially supported by Antenna Technologies, a foundation specialized in research, adaptation and transfer of innovative technologies to fight against poverty and promote sustainable development.

description: Inspire Commerce is a financial technology solutions provider for merchants, customers and developers who want to transact online. Patterned paper is a game-changing technology for delivering low-cost medical care in the developing world. Paper is inexpensive, universally available, and compatible with many biological and chemical assays. To fabricate a diagnostic device, DFA patterns channels and assay zones (or wells) of water-repellant materials into a piece of paper roughly the size of a postage stamp. Biological and chemical assay reagents are then deposited in the wells. When blood, urine, saliva, sweat or other biological samples are applied to the device, the paper wicks the sample through the channels to the assay zones, without external pumps or power. Upon contact, the assay zone quickly changes color and results are then easily read by comparing the color change with a reference scale printed on the device. After use, the device can be easily disposed of by burning.

With their patent-pending technology, Ready Receipts can provide access to Level 3 data without complicated POS requirements.

name: Solstice Initiative
description: Solar has the potential to power every neighborhood but it is primarily the domain of high-income homeowners, with 80 percent of America effectively locked out of the market.
